name: Customer-cortex_company
label: Cortex Tenant Company
description: Owning Company/tenant for this Customer record within Cortex. Required because core ERPNext Customer is not natively Company-scoped; Cortex enforces tenant isolation on top of it via this field.

name: Serial No-cortex_status
label: Cortex Rental Status
options:
Active
Quarantine
Under Repair
Missing
Decommissioned
description: Cortex-specific rental availability status, distinct from ERPNext's native Serial No status. A unit in Quarantine/Under Repair/Missing/Decommissioned is excluded from AvailabilityService's fleet count even if the ERPNext status is still Active.
